classes.term: name identifiers and name authority files: persistent identifiers that disambiguate the names of contributors
classes.basis: field: B1 (isni.org home: 'a persistent unique identifying number in order to resolve the problem of name ambiguity in search and discovery'); B2 (Wikipedia: 'an identifier system for uniquely identifying the public identities of contributors'; 'The system is based primarily on the Virtual International Authority File (VIAF) service'); B4 (BISG: 'disambiguate authors or contributors with the same or similar names'). The census's area for the entity, 'attribution-and-credit' ('Attribution, credit and identity infrastructure: how contributions and names are recorded, disclosed and resolved'), its record_type 'registry' and evidence_kind 'identity registry'.

classes.term: pseudonyms and alternative names of an author, recorded as identities
classes.basis: field: B2 (Wikipedia: 'The ISNI allows a single identity (such as an author's pseudonym or the imprint used by a publisher ) to be identified using a unique number'; 'If an author has published under several different names or pseudonyms, each such name will receive its own ISNI'); B4 (BISG: 'resolving pseudonyms, alternative names, and multiple presentations (scripts, spellings) of a name'). The census's second area for the entity, 'heteronymy' ('Heteronymy, persona and pseudonymous authorship: distinct named authorial functions, human and machine-participating'), and its record.name.

classes.term: attribution of a work to its creator
classes.basis: field: B1 (isni.org home: 'so that every published work can be unambiguously attributed to its creator wherever that work is described'); B4 (BISG: 'An ISNI can also be used to help connect works done by a single author under different or multiple names'). The census's record.keeps and record.function for the entity.
